ubi189_data_source_artifacts_2026_08_26.note: UBI-189 follow-up: depth-0 (top-level, always-visible-without-a-click) field descriptions for all 249 GitHub data sources. 1357 fields filled, via a frequency-prioritized dictionary keyed by individual field name (not per-resource shape -- GitHub's own 184 distinct gap shapes are far more fragmented than Kubernetes' 2-shape ListOptions/version.Info pattern, so the same field name recurring across many otherwise-distinct resources, real GitHub REST API vocabulary like owner/repo/page/per_page/org/enterprise/total_count, gave far more real leverage than per-shape authoring would have). 505 distinct field names covered 100% of the real gap. Depth 1+ deliberately out of scope, same reasoning as Kubernetes: every <Expandable> renders collapsed by default. Keyed data_<wire>, verified zero collisions against GitHub's 48 exact-match sibling wire types.

intros.sourcing_notes: 54 of 68 resources map to their own real, specifically-documented page or section. 14 are real, narrower scopes of a broader documented concept (per-repo tasks inside a variant analysis run, org-scoped variants of a repo-scoped mechanism, comment/review sub-features of a parent resource) -- sourced from that parent per the carried-forward variant rule, not skipped. 0 genuine skips this provider -- unlike Azure's interconnect_block, every GitHub resource had real, findable explanatory content, even where the resource itself (e.g. github_stack -- real Stacked Pull Requests; github_task -- confirmed via the real OpenAPI schema's own code-scanning-variant-analysis-repo-task name before searching) needed the actual GitHub REST API spec cross-referenced first to identify the real feature it maps to, not just its own name. All research via WebSearch/WebFetch against docs.github.com, live, this session, no paid API.
